testcase.name: the Cluster is healthy with one instance outside the mesh, admitted under the restricted Pod Security Standard
the server runs with TLS, AGE preloaded at the image's version, the built-in locale, no superuser password and an owner without superuser rights
AGE runs cypher() in the bundled database
the server refuses a TCP connection without TLS
the migration Job generated the passwords into the empty Secrets the chart declares, and nothing else holds them
a service that lists postgres connects with verify-full, with the mounted CA and its own role
the same pod is refused with another CA, a host name the certificate does not list, or without the admitted labels
helm upgrade with the same values and helm rollback keep the generated passwords
a new password generation replaces every password, and the service and the collector become ready with the new ones
a rollback to the older password generation keeps the new passwords, and so does the upgrade after it
a lost key is regenerated when the Job runs again
helm uninstall keeps the database and the passwords: the Cluster, its image catalog, its volume and the password Secrets stay
